newsitem.title: FRANCE: S&P puts Renault Credit on creditwatch.
newsitem.headline: S&P puts Renault Credit on creditwatch.

text.p: Ratings agency S&P ADEF said in a statement on Wednesday it had put the long-term debt issued by Renault Credit International and its subsidiaries DIAC and Cogera on credit watch with negative implications.
The long-term debt currently carries an A1 rating from S&P ADEF.
The agency also said it confirmed the A-2 rating attributed to short term debt issued by Renault Credit and its subsidiaries.

The statement said the debt had been put on credit watch because of a disappointing performance in the first half of 1996, notably in the automobile sector, which had affected the profitability of the group.
It said the persistence of difficult market conditions could compromise a return to a statisfactory level of profitability.
Renault said on Tuesday its net attributable profit in the first half of 1996 fell to 158 million francs from 1.76 billion a year ago. Its car operation lost 911 million francs.
